input.encoding: [action_count, (opcode, operand)*] with length supplied separately and no count prefix

opcodes.3: query current time; operand must be 0
opcodes.4: query whether the queue is empty; operand must be 0

output.word_sequence: [action_count, action_results..., fired_count, (fired_id, fired_timestamp)*, final_now, final_active_count, total_events_processed]
output.word_encoding: each unsigned 64-bit word as eight little-endian bytes
